traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Siparunaceae: leaves opposite; leaves simple; veins pinnate; leaves evergreen; stipules absent; plants monoecious or dioecious; ovary half inferior; floral cup present; stems woody; flowers in cymes, in spikes or in panicles; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth sepals and petals or tepals; fruit aggregate; stamens 2 to 100; carpels 4 to 100. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
